conditions: Six paired cold Chromium contexts per revision, 390x844 mobile-touch emulation, two-item synthetic OSRS feed, blocked external requests, identical intercepted static transport, CPU sampler on both, ABBA order. Not Android WebView, real network, hardware FPS or real-account performance.
interpretation: Candidate median is 11.9ms slower in this six-trial sample, while both revisions recorded zero long tasks. Treat as a modest synthetic startup delta, not evidence of a main-thread stall; do not generalise to Android or real network performance.
